description: Takes the company's details (name, address, VAT ID, invoice mailbox, whether a purchase order number is required, payment terms, contact) and writes a letter to suppliers in German and English with the mandatory invoice details, the purchase order number rule, the e-invoice format (XRechnung or ZUGFeRD from the EN 16931 profile, as of November 2026 receiving is mandatory in Germany, sending phases in by 2027 and 2028) and where to send. Plus a checklist for the company. Not legal or tax advice. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored, nothing sent. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms, for example "30 days net, 2 % within 10 days".

po_required.description: Is a purchase order number required on every invoice? Default yes.

name: write_invoice_letter
title: Invoice letter: a letter to suppliers with the company's invoice requirements, purchase order number, e-invoice format and payment terms, in German and English
